claim: Collapse the 8,615 retained G1 exploration survivors into semantic structures and coefficient-span behavioral classes, while preserving proposer lineage and explicitly separating known families, combinations, and unresolved novelty.

canonicalization.component_order: sort the two semantic component IR objects by canonical JSON bytes
canonicalization.parameter_names: replace A/B names with an unordered two-coefficient linear span
canonicalization.unit_reparameterization: compare the two-component column span, invariant to nonzero column rescaling and invertible 2x2 basis changes

behavioral_equivalence.definition: same base and normalization, same numerical rank, and indistinguishable projection of deterministic adversarial probes onto the component span

positive: rescale both columns by unequal nonzero constants
apply an invertible triangular 2x2 change of basis
negative: add a 1e-3 adversarial orthogonal mutation to one component

authoritative_origin_status.rule: A class is COMBINATION if any component is mapped to COMBINATION; otherwise it is KNOWN_FAMILY. No class may be called novel from this corpus-only pass.

decision.pass: all 8,615 survivors are assigned to sealed structural and behavioral classes, all authoritative statuses are bounded, all positive and negative mutation controls pass, and confirmation access is zero
decision.block: any survivor is missing or duplicated, any signature is nonfinite or unstable, any mutation control fails, G1 validation fails, or confirmation access occurs
decision.after_pass: authorize G3 whole-galaxy meta-law search without opening confirmation data
